Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

SticsREval (development version)

  • New plot_rrmse_comparison() function to plot the rRMSE of the evaluated version against the reference version, one point per variable, coloured by regression status (#69).
  • New overview_heatmap() function to show the status of every variable for every species in a single heatmap, as on the report’s homepage.
  • New usm_ratio_heatmap() function to show the RMSE ratio of the USM evaluation for each USM and variable, coloured according to the degraded and critical thresholds.
  • The Quarto report generated by render_report() has been refactored and cleaned up (#68).
  • evaluate() no longer writes one HTML scatter plot per degraded variable under plots/<species>/. It now saves, for each species with degraded variables, their observations and simulations to data/<species>_degraded_vars.rds, and the species pages of the report draw the scatter plots from it.

SticsREval 0.1.1

  • The rRMSE comparison plots are now shown in the HTML report (#66).
  • The minimum number of observations criterion (n_obs >= 10) is now applied consistently across the global, species and USM evaluations (#65).

SticsREval 0.1.0

  • First tagged release.
  • evaluate() runs the global, per-species and per-USM statistical evaluations of a STICS version against field observations and against a reference version.
  • balance_closure_test() checks water and nitrogen balance closure for each USM.
  • gen_workspace_from_sms() builds a STICS text workspace from a raw SMS repository, and run_simulations() runs STICS on it and saves the simulation and observation data as RDS files.
  • render_report() renders the evaluation results as a browsable HTML dashboard.
  • A Docker image bundling the package, its dependencies and the Quarto CLI is published on the GitHub Container Registry.
